label: Logos and accreditations
description: A strip of partner, association or certification marks.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.help: For example Accredited by, or Who we work with.

fields.name: columns
fields.label: Columns
fields.help: How many marks sit side by side on a wide screen.

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Mark
fields.help: A transparent PNG or an SVG on a white background reproduces best.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Name
fields.help: The organisation or scheme the mark belongs to. Shown under the mark, and used as its description if the media library has none.

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.help: Optional. Where clicking the mark should go — usually the awarding body.
